description: List. Part of the List APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

q.description: Search text (case sensitivity depends on the endpoint). Optional.

count.description: Page size (number of items returned). Optional.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. Optional.

sortBy.description: Field name to sort by. Optional.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour. Optional.

documentType.description: Document type. Allowed values: DC, RC, TRANSFER_DC, TRANSFER_RC, JOBWORK_DC, JOBWORK_RC, MANUFACTURING_ISSUE, MANUFACTURING_RECEIPT, ADJUSTMENT. Optional.

reportType.description: Report type. Allowed values: NOT_INVOICED, PARTIALLY_INVOICED, FULLY_INVOICED, WITHOUT_CHALLAN, PARTIALLY_WITHOUT_CHALLAN. Optional.

statusCategories.description: Array of status categories values. Allowed values: OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, CANCELLED. Optional.

invoiceStatuses.description: Array of invoice statuses values. Allowed values: NOT_INVOICED, PARTIALLY_INVOICED, FULLY_INVOICED, NOT_APPLICABLE, NOT_BILLED, PARTIALLY_BILLED, FULLY_BILLED. Optional.

accountUniqueNames.description: Array of account unique names values. Optional.

warehouseUniqueNames.description: Array of warehouse unique names values. Optional.

selectAllFields.description: Array of select all fields values. Optional.

amount.description: Monetary amount in company currency unless noted. Optional.

hasLinkedInvoice.description: When true, applies the has linked invoice filter or flag. Optional.

linkableOnly.description: When true, applies the linkable only filter or flag. Optional.

overdueOnly.description: When true, applies the overdue only filter or flag. Optional.

challanTypes.description: Array of challan types values. Allowed values: STOCK_TRANSFER, JOBWORK. Optional.
